evidence: Numerical-uncalibrated simulation (sim/js/concepts/activetether) + catalogue numbers from the phase-1 reports. NOTHING was built, flown or measured. M-070 not_run, G-MATURE closed. Simulation is not verification.

architecture.summary: AT-1: lumbar back unit (MN3110 700 Kv reel, 2:1 belt, yo-yo drum 25 m of 0.36 mm UHMWPE, slip clutch 35 N, ratchet, metering head with tension flexure, 2-axis exit line-angle gimbal, 4S1P P28A, MCU/IMU/GNSS/baro/radio, cutter, 38 N weak link at the exit) with a hinged 0.55 m "scorpion quiver" that is the dock, launch rail and line exit (0.66 m behind / 0.10 m below the pelvis); flyer = 116 g folding umbrella delta (0.094 m², L/D 5.9 ASSUMED polar) with pitot + AoA vane + IMU/GNSS/UWB, two flight servos (bridle pitch / roll), airbrake flaps, 1S 450 mAh cell, 4K-class gyro-EIS camera on a 2-servo pan/tilt mount (48 MP 66° module ASSUMED as default sensor).
architecture.modes: STOWED → (detector start) DEPLOY 1.3 s → READY → (straight glide ≥0.6 s, apparent wind along travel ≥1.35·Vstall on windEstimate + GNSS, tail component ≤3 m/s) LAUNCH (rail release 0.45 m behind the mouth, drift-back pay-out ramp ≤2 m/s to 2.5 m, then tension-controlled to 6 m) → FLY (glide-ratio servo at 50°, roll loop, kite-like length adaptation) → stop: BRAKE (deep stall, slack take-up ≤1 m/s, side-drop in tailwind) → LANDED → RETRIEVE (flagged wing, 3 m/s, 1.5 m/s in the last 3 m; towed at 4 m while still riding) or FLYIN (wind holds it up, flyer behind the rider) → CAPTURE (0.3 m/s, hold while the flyer moves, quiver aligns to the UWB/angle estimate, ASSUMED capture model) → DOCKED → STOWED; ABORT on a detected fall (deep stall, free-spool, cutter at 15 N or a closing flyer); MANUAL stow after 3 missed captures (20 s, +1 op).

decisions.decision: Reel in the lumbar back unit, never on the flyer
decisions.drivenBy: aero H5 (flyer reel → 156–186 g, KE over the cap), engineering B rejected (≈0.20 kg flyer, 12.2 m/s KE cap)

decisions.decision: The reel does not chase tension; it holds length, takes up slack, adapts length slowly (pay out on surplus lift, reel in on a pitot lift deficit, KE-governed), tows and retrieves
decisions.drivenBy: aero H3, control H3/H4; user direction "fly it like a kite" kept as the slow length law

decisions.decision: Elevation held by a glide-ratio servo (airbrake first, then lower CL when the brake saturates)
decisions.drivenBy: aero H9 (fly braked), control physics finding (slope tilts the window forward: 50° above the horizon needs L/D_eff ≈0.7)

decisions.decision: Station defined relative to the exit (devK = 0), not on the mean course
decisions.drivenBy: this build: the shared carving rider swings the pack ±8 m per turn; holding the mean course needs ±5 m of reel stroke per turn and was less stable (sensitivity station_meancourse_0_5)
this build: at 7.5 m the carving swing whips the flyer (more snow contacts and KE); 10 m low-passes it at the cost of bodyPx

decisions.decision: Low apparent wind is a gate: no launch with tail component >3 m/s (windEstimate) or apparent wind along travel <1.35·Vstall; in-flight lift margin <1.15 for 2 s → brake and retrieve
decisions.drivenBy: consensus 3 (aero H2/H11, control H6/H7), towglider tail lesson

decisions.decision: Stops: deep stall + slack take-up only (never fast reel-in); side-drop first in tailwind; fly-in only while the flyer is behind the rider
decisions.drivenBy: aero H11 (fast reel-in 38–145 J), control H8

decisions.decision: Launch only on a straight glide from a 0.45 m rail release with a drift-back pay-out ramp
decisions.drivenBy: control H6 (whip below 5 m while carving), engineering spring launch

decisions.decision: Lumbar exit 0.66 m behind the pelvis
decisions.drivenBy: engineering headClearance table (lumbar 0.55 m ≥1.0 m up to 55°), aero H1

decisions.decision: Camera on the flyer (delta) chosen over the line pod and the low-wing-loading kite
Safety hardware: 38 N weak link at the exit, 35 N slip clutch, cutter, ratchet, KE governor on reel-in

KE.question: control H11 median 32 J vs aero H4 worst 13 J at 130 g
KE.answer: With the pendulum/roll dynamics modelled the 116 g delta reaches KE max 57.08 J (p50 21.65 J, p90 47.86 J) — the control scientist's side was right: the floor ½·m·v_rider² is already ≈10–14 J at 13–15 m/s and swings add 3–6 m/s. Mass sensitivity: ×0.7 → 33.88 J, ×0.5 (58 g) → 40.46 J (keMax judged as max over 48).
KE.verdict: FAIL at 116 g; see mass envelope

headClearClosedLoop.question: control H10 0.01–0.08 m vs engineering ≥1.0 m up to 55°
headClearClosedLoop.answer: In steady braked flight the lumbar exit gives ≥1.0 m (line passes ≈1.06–1.2 m from the helmet at 45–60°), but the 48-case minimum is 0.25 m (p10 0.45 m): the lows occur in tail/cross-wind stops (brake/fly-in/tow-in phases), not in filming flight.
headClearClosedLoop.verdict: engineering right for flight, control right for the full run: FAIL

launchFromBack.question: control H6 whip vs engineering spring launch
launchFromBack.answer: Straight-glide-only launch with a 0.45 m rail release and a ≤2 m/s drift-back ramp succeeds in 90 % of attempts (mean over launched cases); launches are refused when the turns start before the gate opens. ≤2 m/s is slow: 4 m/s sensitivity avail 16.52 %.

dockArrival.question: glider 5.1 m/s vs kite 1.6 m/s vs engineering 60–96 %
dockArrival.answer: Landing behind and towing in at 0.3 m/s with a settle-hold gives capture arrival p50 0.46 / p90 0.73 m/s and first-try dock success 80 % (ASSUMED capture model), dock time p50/p90 13.87/31.25 s.
dockArrival.verdict: arrival speed solved by land-and-tow; first-try ≥98 % and p90 ≤10 s not met

flyerType.question: folding delta vs low-wing-loading kite
flyerType.answer: Kite (0.30 m², 139 g with camera) launches at lower speed but its large area at 12–20 m/s gives tension spikes, weak-link breaks and KE 70.74 J; avail 11.82 % vs delta 16.75 %.

camera.question: on the flyer vs clamped on the line 5–6 m from the exit
camera.answer: The line pod (72 g) sits on the segment that swings with the carving exit (±8 m) and adds a second node: avail 5.3 %, jitter p90 24.16 °/s, and a two-stage dock (pod first) — worse than on the flyer (16.75 %, 10.52 °/s).

clothesline.question: line low behind the rider
clothesline.answer: A lumbar exit at ≈0.8 m height always leaves the first ≈1.79 m behind the quiver below 1.8 m (share of airborne riding time 99.9 %); third-party exposure p50 84.74 s per run. Head clearance (low/rear exit) and the clothesline (high exit) conflict geometrically.

adjustmentsVsEngineering: +2 g pitot/vane and +2.5 g pan servo on the flyer (116 g vs engineering 111 g)
battery energy on the shared 150 Wh/kg basis (32 Wh) instead of the cell rating (40 Wh)
48 MP 66° camera module ASSUMED with the 27 g cam4kNoGimbal mass
kite variant: Ø64 × 0.55 m quiver (2.9 L), 139 g with camera

killTests: Tow-rig polar of the folding delta: kill if ε cannot be held 40–55° with T ≥1.5 N (engineering R6)
50 captures at −10 °C in the quiver from snow tow-in: kill if <95 % first time (engineering R3, towglider audit)
Flight on a carving dummy/rider rig: kill if snow contacts >1 per run or KE >14.9 J at ≥12 m/s with a ≤0.12 kg flyer
Short-line launch from a moving pack (straight glide): kill if <95 % reach 6 m without snow contact
Weak-link/cutter bench: kill if line force on the body exceeds 40 N (50 ms) in snag/fall tests
Head-clearance dummy (tail/cross 3–9 m/s stops): kill if any line/flyer passes <1.0 m from the helmet
Lift/queue/bus IMU log replay (≥500 lift rides): kill if any launch on a lift
